items.title: ゲームはどうすれば“その人の作品”になるのか。岡部佳祐氏の「ストレスものづくり」と，ヨコオタロウ氏の物語に“ひどいこと”が起きる理由［The Tenth Mosaic］
items.summary: 「NieR」シリーズのヨコオタロウ氏と，「ENDERLILIES」の岡部佳祐氏が「TheTenthMosaic」で対談。市場を見る岡部氏の「ストレスものづくり」と，完成されたものは自分で作らないというヨコオ氏が，創作論やゲームを取り巻く変化について話し合った。

zh.title: 游戏如何成为“那个人的作品”？冈部圭介的“压力制造”以及横尾太郎故事中为什么会发生“可怕的事情”【第十张马赛克】
zh.summary: 《NieR》系列的横尾太郎和《ENDERLILIES》的冈部圭介在《TheTenthMosaic》中进行对话。关注市场的冈部先生谈到了“压力制造”，而自称自己不制作成品的横尾先生则讨论了创作理论和围绕游戏的变化。

en.title: How can a game become “that person’s work”? Keisuke Okabe's "stress manufacturing" and why "terrible things" happen in Yoko Taro's story [The Tenth Mosaic]
en.summary: Yoko Taro of the "NieR" series and Keisuke Okabe of "ENDERLILIES" have a conversation on "TheTenthMosaic". Mr. Okabe, who looks at the market, talked about ``stress manufacturing,'' and Mr. Yokoo, who says he doesn't make finished products himself, discussed creation theory and changes surrounding games.

items.title: 見えないところに恐怖は宿る。「アローン・イン・ザ・ダーク」「サイレントヒル」「零」「クロックタワー」の作り手が語るホラーの原点と美学［The Tenth Mosaic］

zh.title: 恐惧存在于你看不到的地方。 《鬼屋孤独》、《寂静岭》、《零》和《钟楼》的创作者讲述恐怖的起源和美学【第十张马赛克】

en.title: Fear dwells in places you can't see. The origin and aesthetics of horror as told by the creator of “Alone in the Dark,” “Silent Hill,” “Zero,” and “Clock Tower” [The Tenth Mosaic]

ja.title: 月は玄方を照らし、心は定命の世界に戻る：「明潮」バージョン3.7の体験記
ja.summary: 注: この記事には、バージョン 3.7 のコア プロットの説明が含まれます。この記事はゲームクリア後に読むことをお勧めします。 「明朝」バージョン 3.7 のメインストーリー「孟叔の心と心」を完了した後、私は急いで玄方市を離れず、再び玄方市に戻りました。この時期、朝月節は街路の両側にイルミネーションが灯り、賑わう人々が賑やかにおしゃべりし、夜空には花火が咲き誇り、にぎやかになっています。 3.5 から 3.7 まで、「Ming Tide」は 3 つのバージョンを使用し、Xuanfang ランドの過去、現在、未来を少しずつプレイヤーの前にレイアウトしました。最終章に至るまで、物語はついに、すべての伝説の背後に常に存在してきた名前、Xinyue Fox を中心に展開しなくなりました。かつては隋州の伝説の中にのみ存在していたこの人物は、最終的には遠い神秘の感覚を失い、放浪者の物語に残りました。 「心」、Xinyue Fox、そして過去200年間に玄芳市で起こったすべてのことが徐々にまとめられたとき、私はずっと歩いてきたことに気づきました。

en.title: The moon shines on Xuanfang, and the heart returns to the world of mortals: Notes on the experience of version 3.7 of "Ming Tide"
en.summary: Note: This article will involve the core plot description of version 3.7. It is recommended to read this article after completing the game. After completing the main storyline of version 3.7 of "Ming Chao" "Meng Shu's Heart-to-Heart", I didn't rush to leave Xuanfang City, but went back to the city again. At this time, the Chaoyue Festival has become lively, with lights on both sides of the street, bustling crowds chatting lively, and fireworks blooming in the night sky. From 3.5 to 3.7, "Ming Tide" used three versions, laying out the past, present and future of Xuanfang land in front of players bit by bit. Until the final chapter, the story finally no longer revolves around the name that has always existed behind all legends - Xinyue Fox. This character who once only existed in the legend of Suizhu finally lost his distant sense of mystery and remained in the story of the Wanderer. When the "heart", Xinyue Fox, and everything that had happened in Xuanfang City in the past two hundred years were gradually put together, I realized that I had walked all the way.

PvEPvE has ushered in major changes, including AI behavior logic optimization and a new game progress mechanism, further improving the game experience that players are already familiar with: Reincarnation: Players can unlock 6 reincarnation levels in PvE, each level comes with special rewards, including the in-game currency TarCoin. en.title: Why do we still need an “offline figure party” with 150,000 people?

Following the crowds pouring into the venue, you will find a phenomenon that is rarely seen in other exhibitions: among the 150,000 or so offline attendees, you can see everywhere dragging huge hard-shell suitcases, folding trolleys with reinforced straps, and even young people carrying professional shock-proof photography bags. If you don’t know the modeling circle, you might think that these people are moving in this huge exhibition hall. But if you are a senior glue guy, a prototype artist, or someone who simply has a preference for the materialization of two-dimensional characters, you will understand it clearly - those boxes are filled with the purpose of properly protecting fragile, delicate, three-dimensional art that often takes months of hard work to create.
